maintenance_led.reason: MRO distribution of bearings, pumps, safety and industrial supplies to run existing plants, plus pump repair and rebuild services.

publicly_funded.reason: Customers are private industrial firms in manufacturing, oil and gas, agriculture and construction, not government payers.

serial_acquirer.reason: Acquisitions are a historical part of strategy, but growth is mainly organic distribution sales; only occasional deals.

mission_critical.reason: Mostly distributed MRO products bought from many suppliers; switching suppliers is relatively easy, despite some service and inventory-management integration.

notes: Serial acquirer and mission-critical judgments are borderline; DXP has a long acquisition history and some embedded supply chain services.
